headline: ChatGPT business profiles are here. The traffic is not, yet.
dek: OpenAI opened business profiles in ChatGPT on Nov 10. Early numbers from one jeweler: 46 mentions, 5 profile views and 6 site visits in 28 days.
why: Claiming the profile is cheap for a single-location business, but the early numbers say not to expect real lead volume from it yet.
doThis: Claim yours if you have 15 minutes, then check the numbers in a month before spending more time on it.
